notes: s007 καί is unrepresented: the ASV writes no adjunctive word before *others* (rule 65's English-side test).

ἀνά is unrepresented under rules 34 and 94: the ASV spreads the distributive over *two and two*, so no single English word answers to the preposition, and each numeral keeps its own token with the rule 29 juncture on the second.
